newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds see light spot trading.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds see light spot trading.

text.p: Trading on the UK meals and feeds market was mainly for spot material on Tuesday.
High protein soymeal fetched 207 stg a tonne for spot delivery ex-store Tilbury and Humberside while on the the south coast 208 stg was paid.
On the rapemeal resale market spot A.D.M. material traded at 128 stg a tonne with fixings.
Brokers said there was no real volume behind the trades.
"People are only buying what they need when they need to, so all we are seeing is odd lorry loads being done here and there," said one.
